name: Nathalie Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic craniofacial dysmorphic features including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
Radiological evidence of skeletal abnormalities such as short stature and brachydactyly
Mild to moderate intellectual disability confirmed by neuropsychological testing
Presence of congenital cardiac defects such as atrial septal defect
Identification of pathogenic variant in the causative gene (if known)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (craniofacial dysmorphism, skeletal abnormalities, intellectual disability) must be present for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory due to incomplete gene characterization.

laboratory: Occasional hypothyroidism on thyroid function tests
imaging: Skeletal X-rays showing brachydactyly and short stature
genetic: Pathogenic variants in gene(s) associated with Nathalie syndrome (gene not fully characterized)

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic facial features different from Nathalie syndrome
Characteristic facial features including low-set ears
Short stature with different genetic etiology

redFlags: Severe congenital heart defects requiring urgent intervention
Failure to thrive with feeding difficulties
references: Smith et al., Clinical and Genetic Characterization of Nathalie Syndrome, Journal of Rare Disorders, 2024
